capabilities: Generate text embeddings for notes via the OpenAI API
Find notes related to the active note by embedding similarity
Display related notes in a side panel
extras: Much of the README is standard plugin-template boilerplate (releasing, ESLint, funding URLs); the OpenAI API key must be entered in the plugin settings tab. The README also notes the Obsidian API was in early alpha at the time of writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to surface notes that are semantically similar to the one you are viewing.
summary: Adds a side panel that uses OpenAI text embeddings to find and display notes related to the current note.
